components.css: .ds-recovery { display: grid; gap: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; color: var(--ink, #172b46); list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c1cb); font: 1rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-recovery li { --ds-state: var(--blue, #2f6fb2); display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(6rem, 8rem) 1fr; gap: .65rem; align-items: baseline; padding: .8rem .3rem .8rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #b7c1cb); background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ds-state) 0 .45rem, transparent .45rem); } .ds-recovery__lamp { width: .65rem; aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--ds-state); border: 1px solid var(--navy, #10233f); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-recovery__tag { color: var(--ink-soft, #496078); font: 700 .82rem/1 "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-recovery__fault { --ds-state: var(--red, #d94f59) !important; } .ds-recovery__restart { --ds-state: var(--yellow, #f0b429) !important; } .ds-recovery__healthy { --ds-state: var(--green, #16845b) !important; } .ds-recovery strong { color: #0d6d49; font-weight: 750; }

narrative.overview:
Floodgate looks like a powder-coated incident-command surface, not a generic developer landing page. Deep navy shells hold warm white reading plates, yellow action plates, and blue operational panels. Inset lines, visible fasteners, status lamps, and colored state rails make each unit feel replaceable and independently monitored.

The system is dense but calm. Large condensed headings state the operating claim; plain body text explains it; monospace tags and commands show the machine evidence. Fault, restart, and recovery stay visible as neighboring states rather than becoming decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Powder-coated navy, white, yellow, and blue panel materials.
Structural borders, inset rims, fasteners, and state rails instead of generic cards.
Condensed display type paired with readable system text and compact monospace evidence.
A warm ruled-paper field behind a compact, bounded operations shell.
Progressive enhancement and explicit motion, contrast, and focus behavior.

rules.name: The State Has a Name Rule
rules.body: Never rely on red, yellow, green, or blue alone. Pair every state color with a tag, label, or outcome.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve solid yellow for active navigation, launch surfaces, copy controls, focus, selection, and the recovery transition. Do not use it as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Warm Field Rule
rules.body: Reading surfaces are warm paper or warm white; do not introduce cool gray application backgrounds.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use condensed type for human-facing authority, the body stack for explanation, and monospace only for machine-facing evidence.

rules.name: The Short Display Rule
rules.body: Balance display headings and constrain their measure. Do not use the condensed face for paragraphs.

rules.name: The Neighbor Isolation Rule
rules.body: Large surfaces may share a wall, but each must keep its own border, inset rim, state rail, and padding. Do not merge operational units into an undifferentiated feature grid.

rules.name: The Mounted, Not Floating Rule
rules.body: A panel earns depth through an outer stroke, inset rim, material texture, and visible fasteners. Do not use a shadow by itself to make a generic card.

rules.name: The Contrast-Safe Structure Rule
rules.body: Every elevated surface must remain distinct when shadows are removed.

rules.name: The Tight Radius Rule
rules.body: Corners must look fabricated, not soft. Do not apply large consumer-app radii to plates or controls.

dos: Do keep the navy shell, warm reading field, yellow action plate, and labeled red/green/blue state system.
Do construct important surfaces from border, inset rim, powder texture, fasteners, and restrained depth.
Do preserve the 70-character reading measure and the display/body/mono role split.
Do keep launch commands copyable, warnings adjacent, and no-JavaScript states honest.
Do preserve keyboard focus, skip navigation, reduced-motion, and increased-contrast behavior.
Do attach provenance to each shipping raster and record enough information to regenerate it.
donts: Don't replace the wall with a generic hero followed by interchangeable feature cards.
Don't use state colors without a textual tag or outcome.
Don't use large soft radii, borderless floating cards, or shadow as the only depth cue.
Don't turn monospace into a body face or Barlow Condensed into paragraph text.
Don't show inert copy or search controls before their behavior is available.
Don't introduce untraceable raster decoration or hand-edit a generated raster.
